name: Build the link graph
description: Turns annotated provisions and the typed links between them into a graph: each instrument a group, each provision a node inside it, each link an edge labelled with its type. Shows a short summary before passing the graph on.

config.label: Group provisions by instrument
config.help: Collapse provisions into one node per instrument. Needs the visualizer's compound-node support (parent field); without it the graph is flat.
